title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Tea Party on 1969-12-30
source: Recording Info: SBD -> Cass Master (Ampex C-90 Master Cass/no dolby) -> Cass (Tascam 122mkIII Cass 1st Gen) -> Dat (Technics 3800/44.1k) Transfer Info: Dat (Sony R500) -> Prodif Plus -> Samplitude v6.0 -> SHN

ai_review.summary: A‑plus soundboard capture of a legendary 12/30/69 show with smoking Dark Star → Alligator → Drums → The Eleven and standout New Speedway Boogie, Black Peter and Uncle John’s Band.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑tuned soundboard delivers crystal‑clear, balanced audio that lets the band’s improvisational fire shine through. Highlights include a 20‑minute Dark Star suite, an electrifying New Speedway Boogie, and a fiery Uncle John’s Band, while Jerry’s SG guitar tone is repeatedly praised. Overall the performance is described as tight, cohesive, and one of the finest snapshots of ’69 Dead.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly enthusiastic reviews (mostly 5‑star) praise both the musical performance and the A+ soundboard; only minor, isolated complaints appear.

recording_quality.technical_notes: A+ soundboard mix, crisp and balanced throughout; a single note of slight vocal distortion on Uncle John’s Band but otherwise flawless.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Alligator > Drums > The Eleven
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set described as a continuous, high‑energy journey from start to finish; the jam sections are tight, cohesive and dramatically dynamic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His SG guitar is 'fired up' with perfect tone and an early lead exploration on Uncle John’s Band.
